messages:
Maya: FYI pulled the last 5 onboarding debriefs. CSAT slipped from 4.6 -> 3.8 for two accounts after they hit billing setup. repeating asks: per-route billing toggle hard to find, cost estimate examples missing, and they want a short setup video.
Maya: example verbatim: "We spent 30m looking for billing toggle, eventually gave up and asked support" (Northpoint). 
Diego: rough counts? which accounts and renewal risk?
Maya: Northpoint (paid, renewal in 6w, flagged), ClearWell (pilot, 3 teams), EdgeLabs (trial, security asking for team keys).
Priya: ok, product signal: console discoverability + docs + quickstart video. low-effort fixes first.
Sam: engineering question: is the toggle buried under advanced settings? if so we can surface it with a badge + inline help copy. estimate 1 dev day + 0.5 ux.
Priya: also need a one-page cost matrix for CSMs to share (per 10k/100k tokens at typical prompt shapes). ops/finance help?
Maya: asked billing for a simple sheet. will paste numbers when ready.
Diego: for renewal risk, Northpoint is high. I recommend immediate outreach and a short walkthrough + apply quick UX fix as a canary.
Priya: can we make a 60s screen recording for CSMs to use? I can script it and Sam can do the recording. 24-48h.
Sam: noted. I'll scope the frontend change and the recording. Can we backlog the team-API-keys ask separately? it's a bigger auth change.
Maya: yes backlog team-keys under security+api and include in the quarterly roadmap triage.
Ezra-bot: CS-3201 created: "Onboarding friction: surface per-route billing toggle + enablement video + cost matrix" assigned Priya, due 3d, priority P1 for Northpoint follow-up.
Priya: picking up CS-3201. I'll post a short playbook for CSMs after the mock.
Diego: I'll ping the renewal owner and mark Northpoint as at-risk in the tracker.
Maya: also saved raw transcript snippets to the ticket. Posting two more short quotes: "No idea how much this will cost us monthly" (ClearWell), "We need team API keys for staging access" (EdgeLabs).
Sam: thanks. once billing sheet is in I'll add a small cost-preview link in the tooltip.
Priya: plan: (1) mock tooltip + badge (2) 60s recording + email template (3) cost matrix inserted in docs (4) backlog team-keys. ETA: mock + recording script 48h.
Diego: agreed. I'll coordinate outreach to Northpoint. Maya, can you lead comms?
Maya: will do. Drafting a short message and scheduling a 15m walkthrough.
Priya: tagging signals: onboarding-ux, billing-visibility, enablement-video, api-keys-request.
Maya: thanks all 64c small ops like this moving sooner will likely change renewal outcome.
Diego: noted, will follow up after canary.
